projectDescription: A cross-platform desktop Swiss Army knife for developers that ships 30+ built-in tools and exposes an extensible MEF-based SDK for building and distributing custom tool extensions.
keyFeatures: 30+ built-in developer tools (converters, encoders, formatters, generators, testers, text utilities, graphics)
Extensible MEF-based plugin architecture for building custom tools
Cross-platform support: Windows (WinUI/WPF), macOS, and Linux (GTK4)
CLI mode alongside GUI — every tool is also accessible from the command line
Smart Detection automatically identifies clipboard content and routes it to the right tool
Monaco Editor integration for rich syntax-highlighted text inputs
NuGet/VSIX-style extension packaging and installation via Extensions Manager
Fluent Design System UI with Mica material on Windows 11
publicApiSurface: IGuiTool — implement to create a GUI tool (View + OnDataReceived)
ICommandLineTool — implement to create a CLI tool (InvokeAsync)
IDataTypeDetector — implement for Smart Detection (TryDetectDataAsync)
ISettingsProvider — get/set/reset typed settings (GetSetting, SetSetting, ResetSetting)
IResourceAssemblyIdentifier — expose fonts and resource managers for an extension assembly
IMefProvider — import MEF components on demand (Import, ImportMany, SatisfyImports)
GuiToolGroup — declare a named group/category in the navigation sidebar
UIToolView — root container for a tool's UI, supports dialogs and scrolling
[ToolDisplayInformationAttribute] — metadata: icon, group, localized title/description
[CommandNameAttribute] / [CommandLineOptionAttribute] — CLI command name and options
[DataTypeNameAttribute] / [AcceptedDataTypeNameAttribute] — Smart Detection wiring
[TargetPlatformAttribute] — restrict a component to Windows, macOS, or Linux
[OrderAttribute] — control ordering of tools or groups relative to named components
[MenuPlacementAttribute] — place a tool in body or footer of the navigation
[NotSearchable] / [NotFavorable] / [NoCompactOverlaySupportAttribute] — opt-out flags
PredefinedCommonDataTypeNames — string constants for built-in detected data types
PredefinedCommonToolGroupNames — string constants for built-in tool group names
GUI.* static factory methods — fluent builder for IUIElement components (Button, Stack, Label, MultiLineTextInput, SplitGrid, etc.)
SandboxedFileReader — safe cross-platform file access inside tool implementations
SettingDefinition<T> — typed definition object for a user-configurable setting
ConsoleProgressBar — helper for displaying progress in CLI tools
